name: gooey-counter
title: Gooey Counter
description: Canvas-based animated counter that morphs pixel-grid blocks between numbers 0–10 using an SVG gooey filter. Blocks scatter to a random layout between each number with eased transitions.

changelog.summary: Changed the default and maximum counter range to 0..100.
Removed value/textColor/prefix from the public prop surface, capped maxValue at 50, and added working gridSize and roundedness controls.

Added maxValue, duration, blobColor, and backgroundColor as public props. The originally suggested value/prefix props didn't fit this effect's actual behavior (it loops 0..maxValue continuously rather than counting once to a fixed value, and has no text label to prefix), so they were replaced with props that reflect what the component really does.
Snap digits and skip scatter morph under reduced motion

props.name: maxValue
props.description: Upper bound of the looping 0..maxValue count sequence.

props.name: gridSize
props.description: Number of grid columns used by the morphing counter.

props.name: duration
props.description: Pace multiplier for the count/morph animation (1 = default speed).

props.name: roundedness
props.description: Corner rounding for each gooey grid cell.

props.name: blobColor
props.description: Color of the gooey animated blocks.
